name: Week 17 KB Saturday Cardio — Conditioning (Spotlight: Snatch; Controlled-Power Finisher)
description: Saturday KB OPTION — pure conditioning, distinct from Tue (strength/circuit) and Thu (lighter skill template). Light bell throughout (16-20lb) — breathing rate and sustainability are the targets, not load. A deliberately compact day so it stays a clean skip when the week's been heavy: the Asgooch cardio complex carries over, then the finisher rotates this week to a controlled-power block (around-body pass / side swing / high pull / goblet squat — no running, no jumping, just controlled power). Spotlight on the snatch. Choice-of-the-day on D6 alongside stairmaster, easy run, or rest.

dayOverview.theme: Saturday conditioning — light bell, breathing-rate target. Kept compact: Asgooch cardio complex + a controlled-power finisher, no extra flow-combo block — so it's a clean skip on a heavy week and doesn't bleed into a strong Monday. Day after Friday legs — squatting stays LIGHT on purpose. Spotlight: the snatch punch-through.

spotlights.why: The technical centerpiece of the Asgooch cardio complex and the most right-shoulder-relevant move on a light-bell day. Spotlight the hip-drive + punch-through + soft catch so the bell doesn't bang the wrist or crash the shoulder at the top — the move that most rewards clean mechanics on a conditioning day.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W15 brutal-complex-variant finisher · W16 100-rep block finisher · W17 controlled-power finisher (current) · W18 cycle forward — a fresh complex or back to a high-rep block. The Asgooch cardio complex stays; the finisher rotates so Saturday stays fresh.
watchpoints: **Saturday is optional and deliberately compact** — keep it a clean skip when the week's been heavy. The point is to not over-train into a weak Monday; weekends stay light.
**Day after Friday legs.** Squatting (front squat × 6 in the complex; the finisher goblet squat) stays LIGHT — 16-20lb. Skip the squat reps if the QL/quads are talking.
**Light bell is the whole point** — 16-20lb working. Conditioning means breathing rate, not bell weight.
**Asgooch CARDIO complex ≠ Tuesday's OVERHEAD complex** — same author, different chain. Cardio = row/clean/squat/snatch (low-and-explosive).
**Snatch spotlight** — hips drive the bell, punch the hand THROUGH at the top for a soft catch, no bang on the wrist. Sub high pulls if the right shoulder crackles on the catch.
**Finisher rotated to controlled-power** — no running, no jumping, just smooth controlled power. Light bell, keep moving; break the reps into chunks if needed.
**Choice-of-the-day on D6** — not mandatory. Skip if Friday legs cooked you; swap for stairmaster / easy run if cardio-only is the call. No pull-up greasing here — Saturday is the conditioning flank.

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Loosen the shoulders fast — the cardio complex is its own warmup.
Easy two-handed swings. Prime the hinge.
Light, open the hips. Skip if Friday legs left the quads sore.
Standing, torso hinged slightly forward. Wakes the grip + forearm + posterior chain — primes the snatch catch.

exercises.notes: Mini-band overhead.

sets.notes: **Abbreviated prep** — 4 moves instead of the full 7. Saturday is conditioning; the full 7-move prep is overkill for a light-bell day.

sets.name: 🔆 Asgooch Cardio Complex — LEFT (Spotlight: Snatch)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Left hand. Hips back, back flat, pull the elbow past the ribs. 2s pull, 2s lower.
Left hand. **Hip drive into the rack** — thumb to collarbone. Smooth catch — knees absorb.
Left rack. **LIGHT** — Friday legs is yesterday. Sit tall, full depth IF the legs are fresh; reduce depth before load if they're cooked.

Left hand. 🔆 **SPOTLIGHT — the punch-through:**
- **Hips drive the bell**, not the arm — the hinge throws it overhead
- **Punch the hand THROUGH at the top** — the bell rotates around the wrist and you punch up to meet it, so it settles soft with no bang
- **Soft catch, ribs down at lockout** — the bell stacks over the shoulder
- **Right shoulder watch on the catch** — sub high pulls for the last 2 rounds if it crackles

sets.notes: 5 rounds LEFT. Continuous within a round — row → clean → squat → snatch with no rest. Rest 30-45s between rounds. **Weak side first.** Different from Tuesday's overhead Asgooch — same author, different chain.

sets.name: Asgooch Cardio Complex — RIGHT

exercises.notes: Right hand. Same form — hips back, full extension.
Right hand. Smooth clean to the rack.
Right rack. Same depth/load discipline as the left.
Right hand. **Spotlight punch-through + right shoulder watchpoint on the catch** — same modify-to-high-pull rule.

sets.notes: 5 rounds RIGHT. Continuous within a round. **If the workout is running long after the left side, drop to 3-4 rounds right — don't grind a quality session into a sloppy one.**

sets.name: 🌀 Controlled-Power Finisher — Smooth & Light (Rotated In for W17)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Smooth circles around the body, alternate direction halfway. Core tight, torso quiet.
Side-to-side swings across the body — controlled arc, drive from the hips, core rotation. No jerking.
Explosive hip snap, pull the bell to chin height, elbows high, controlled lower. **Right shoulder watch** — keep it light; the hip snap does the work, not the arm.
Full depth, chest up — **LIGHT**, Friday legs is yesterday. Skip or halve the reps if the quads are tight; smooth controlled tempo, not a burnout.

sets.notes: **Controlled-power finisher — no running, no jumping, just smooth controlled power.** One pass through the four: pass → side swing → high pull → squat. Break each into chunks (e.g. 2×20-25) if needed; rest ~30s between moves. Light bell, posture + control focus, keep the breathing rate up.

exercises.notes: Slow spine wave. Decompress after the finisher.
60s each side. Hip flexor release — counters the cardio-complex squat reps.
60s. Adductors take a hit from the lateral shapes.

tips: **Saturday conditioning option — choice-of-the-day on D6.** Alternates with stairmaster, easy run, or rest. Skip if Friday legs cooked you; deliberately compact so skipping it costs nothing.
**LIGHT bell throughout: 16-20lb working.** This is the whole point. Conditioning = breathing rate, not load.
**Core block carries over:** the Asgooch CARDIO complex (row/clean/squat/snatch × 6 × 5 rounds per side).
**Finisher rotated to controlled-power** — around-body pass / side swing / high pull / goblet squat, no running or jumping, smooth controlled tempo. Chunk the reps if needed.
**Spotlight: the snatch punch-through** — hips drive, punch the hand through, soft catch. Sub high pulls if the catch crackles.
**Squatting stays LIGHT** — Friday legs is yesterday. Skip the squat reps if the quads are tight.
**Right shoulder watch on the snatch + high pull** — light bell, smooth catch; high pulls if it crackles.
**No pull-up greasing here** — Saturday is the conditioning flank.
Rotation plan: W18 rotates the finisher again so Saturday stays fresh.
formPhilosophy: Saturday is conditioning, distinct from the Tue and Thu KB days. Light bell, more reps. Kept deliberately compact — the Asgooch complex plus a rotating finisher — so it's a genuine choice, not an obligation: easy to skip on a heavy week without losing the program's thread, and light enough that it never bleeds into a weak Monday. Building decades, not weeks.
